description: PJM real-time five-minute locational marginal prices (LMP $/MWh) by pricing node, with the total price and its congestion and marginal-loss components. PJM is the largest US grid operator (13 states + DC, ~65M people). Use for "PJM power price right now", "PJM Western Hub price", "which PJM nodes are congested". Requires a PJM API key.

_apiKey.description: PJM Data Miner 2 subscription key. Free at https://apiportal.pjm.com/.

datetime_beginning_ept.description: Eastern Prevailing Time range filter in Data Miner syntax, e.g. "9/17/2026 00:00 to 9/17/2026 23:59". Omit for the most recent intervals.

pnode_id.description: Filter to one PJM pricing-node id (e.g. 51288 for Western Hub).

pnode_name.description: Filter to one pricing-node name (e.g. "WESTERN HUB").

name: pjm_lmp_realtime
title: Pjm Lmp Realtime
